Name: Phineas
Dialog: So, Ferb, what do you wanna do today? (Ferb shrugs) What about Perry? What does he want to do? (Perry chatters) Well, he's a platypus. They don't do much. I, for one, am starting to get bored, and boredom is something up with which I will not put! The first thing they're gonna ask us when we get back to school is "what did we do over summer?". I mean, no school for three months. Our life should be a rollercoaster! And I mean a **good** rollercoaster, not like that one we rode at the state fair.

Name: Ride attendant
Dialog: Please exit to the left.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Man, that was lame. Why, if I built a rollercoaster, I would... That's it! I know what we're gonna do today!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Phineas, Ferb. I'm gonna go pick up a few things. You boys stay out of trouble, okay?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Okay, mom. (to Ferb) We're gonna build a rollercoaster!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (In the driveway, Linda gets into the car; comes over) I'm in charge, right? You did tell them I'm in charge?

Name: Linda
Dialog: Relax, Candace. Nobody has to be in charge.

Name: Candace
Dialog: But what if there's an emergency?

Name: Linda
Dialog: Like what?

Name: Candace
Dialog: What if a... (gasps) What if a satellite falls out of orbit and crashes into the house? (smiles)

Name: Linda
Dialog: If that happens, you're in charge.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yes! (enters the backyard to see the boys) Mom says I'm in charge, conditionally.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (He and Ferb are working on something with drafting tables.) Whatever.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Wait a minute, what are you doing?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Homework.

Name: Candace
Dialog: It's summer.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: That's cool. You wait till the last minute then.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Well, I'm watching you. (walks into the house and closes the door, then opens it shortly after) And I'm in charge, conditionally! (closes the door again; looks out the window, then answers her video phone when it rings.) Hello? Oh, hi, Stacy! No, I can't go to the mall right now. Mom just went to the store, she left me in charge, well, you know, conditionally. (Phineas and Ferb walk past with lots of wooden planks.) Oh if you go, can you see if Jeremy is there? No, no, he's the cute one that works at Mr. Slushy Burger. (Phineas and Ferb walk past with steel beams.) Yeah, he totally smiled at me last time I was there. I just about died. No, I told you I can't. I'm watching my brother and stepbrother. (Phineas and Ferb walk past with sinks and toilets.) Yeah, and they never get into trouble ‘cause Mom never catches them. One of these days though, I'm going to see to it that she catches them red-handed. (Phineas and Ferb walk past with a flamingo and a lion in a cage that roars loudly.) Will you hold it down?! I am trying to use the phone! (at Stacy) Mom left me in charge, so there will be no shenanigans today. What are they doing right now? Why do you ask? What do you mean you can see it from your house? See what?! (She runs out to the backyard and stares in shock upon seeing the rollercoaster that Phineas and Ferb are building.) Phineas, what is this?!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Do you like it?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ooh, I'm gonna go tell mom and when she sees what you are doing, you are going down! (runs off) Down, down, down! (Phineas and Ferb look blankly while she walks away.) D-O-W-N, down!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We're gonna need a blowtorch and some more peanut butter.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (she walks up the driveway while Candace rides off on her bike.) Hey, Candace. Is Phineas… home?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Down, down, I say!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (she walks into the backyard; hearts in eyes) Hey, Phineas.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, Isabella.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: What'cha doin'?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Building a roller coaster.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: In your backyard?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Some of it.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Wow. Isn't that kind of impossible?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Some might say.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Hey, Ferb. (Ferb waves with the hammer.) Does your stepbrother ever talk?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ferb? He's more of a man of action. (Ferb hits the nail with his hammer and then his nose.)

Name: Isabella
Dialog: I was gonna go to the pool, you wanna go swimming?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Kind of in the middle of something here.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Oh, right. Okay, I'll see you later then. (leaves)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Okay. (at Ferb) Hey, Ferb, you got enough rivets up there? (Ferb gives a thumbs up showing they have rivets.) Hey, where's Perry?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Good morning, Agent P. The evil Dr. Doofenshmirtz is up to his old tricks. For reasons unknown to us, he bought up 80 percent of the country's tinfoil. I want you to get over to his hideout right away, find out what he's up to and put a stop to it. As always, Agent P, it is imperative that your cover identity as a mindless domestic pet remains intact. Now, get out there. We're all counting on you. (Agent P jumps into his hovercraft and flies through a tunnel. He leaves through a stone and holds his fedora down to hide from the brothers.)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: So, the way I see it, the solid fuel rockets kick in at the mall's parking lot, then we release the snakes during the corkscrew around the interstate. I'm gonna go get the snakes. (Ferb puts on his mask and starts using the blowtorch.)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom, you gotta come home right now.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Did a satellite crash into the house?

Name: Candace
Dialog: No, no, no! You gotta see what Phineas and Ferb are doing!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Seems like we've had this conversation before.

Name: Candace
Dialog: What do you mean?

Name: Linda
Dialog: I seem to recall you telling me that the boys were training monkeys to juggle bicycles, and when I come home, there was a stunning lack of monkeys.

Name: Candace
Dialog: I still don't know how they cleaned that up so fast.

Name: Linda
Dialog: So, what's the emergency this time?

Name: Candace
Dialog: They're building a rollercoaster!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Candace, seriously, isn't Phineas a little young to be a rollercoaster engineer?

Name: Foreman
Dialog: Aren't you a little young to be a rollercoaster engineer?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Yes. Yes, I am.

Name: Foreman
Dialog: Well, I must say, I'm very impressed. The forms all seem to be in order, although I've never seen them filled out in crayon before. So, if there's anything I can get you, anything at all, just let me know.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Do you think we could borrow one of those gadgets? (A robot arm fixing a car is shown.)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Now, this is the life.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ah, Perry the Platypus, what an unexpected surprise. And by unexpected, I mean: Completely expected! (He presses a button. Mechanical arms seize Agent P.) I, Dr. Heinz Doofenshmirtz, have covered the entire eastern seaboard in tinfoil, and when I put my giant magnet next to my ingenious Magnetism Magnifier, I will pull the East in a westerly direction, thereby reversing the rotation of the Earth. You may well ask yourself, why would he do this? What could he possibly have to gain? Well, let me just answer that by saying I haven't really worked out all the bugs yet. I mean, you know, tinfoil alone costs a lot. (While Doofenshmirtz is talking, Agent P tries getting free, then notices a screw on the floor at his feet. Looking around him, he formulates a plan.)

Name: Candace
Dialog: But, Mom, I'm telling you, they're building it, and it's huge! (Ferb puts up a poster. She reads it.) "Phineas and Ferb present the Coolest Coaster Ever now open"? (runs off) Mom!

Name: Pedro
Dialog: Phineas and Ferb got a roller coaster? You think we get a discount if we bring the flier?

Name: Dimitri
Dialog: Maybe we better take it. (They take it with them just as Candace brings Linda over.)

Name: Candace
Dialog: (gestures toward the empty post, head turned away) There, look, look, look, see? I told you I'm not crazy, I told you!

Name: Linda
Dialog: (dryly) And you're not crazy because...? (Candace turns toward the post where the poster was and screams.) I see your point, Candace. No crazy person would scream at a post like that. I'll be in the dairy section if you wanna come yell at some cheese, or anything.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ladies and gentlemen, boys and girls, children of all ages! May I present to you a spectacle most of the morning in the making: The Coolest...Coaster...EVER! (Ferb pulls a rope to unveil the rollercoaster. The camera pans up to its top. A bird files into it and falls.) So, who wants to go first? (The bird falls behind Phineas. The entire audience raise their hands.)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (cntd) To fasten, insert the tab into the metal buckle. To release, just pull back on the— (drops the seatbelt) Oops. Well, you get the picture. Well, that's about it. Enjoy the ride. (The car goes over the top, and stops, viewing the extended drop.) You all signed the waivers, right? (The car quickly drops as everyone screams. It goes through loops, hairpin turns, and a corkscrew, then a load of rubber snakes drop on it.) Relax, they're just rubber! (The car goes into a bucket of mud, then exits and gets cleaned through a car wash.) Hey, look, here comes the AH-AH-AH-AH! (The section of the rollercoaster spells out "AAAA" and goes past the building with "!" on its side. The car zooms around the D.E.I. building.)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: …When I really make all my money back, I-I-I could buy a bunch of east-facing real estate, and sell it again with a- (Agent P sends a screw at him, which he ducks for.) Ha! You missed! (The screw flies to the roof and hits a line, which throws it back at his foot.) Oowwww! Ow, ow, ow, owwww! (He jumps around and accidentally releases Agent P, who quickly punches him. The two have a swordfight with wrenches, then Agent P hits his foot.) Owww! (He rolls a battery cart into Perry, who jumps over it, causing the cart to fall outside through a window. He then pulls a lever, opening the top of the building.) Now, you are too late! (the Magnetism Magnifier activates) Quake in your boots and watch helplessly, as the unimaginable electromagnetic forces pull the eastern seaboard, thereby reversing rotation of the- (The tinfoil releases from the buildings.) Well, that didn't work. (The tinfoil creates an enormous ball, gliding through the air.) And now, we have a two-ton ball of tinfoil traveling 200 miles an hour directly at us! (He and Perry run to the Magnifier) Quickly! We must separate the magnet from the Magnifier before it's too late!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Now I know I have that club card in here somewhere. I always have it with me, but my purse is such a disaster area, you know how it is.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (goes outside and sees the coaster) Oh, oh, oh, oh, oh! Mom! Mom! (rushes off)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: It's no use! It's no use! We are doomed! (Agent P sees a helicopter. He jumps onto the magnet and fires a grappling hook at it. He quickly wraps some of the rope around the magnet. The helicopter flies off, taking the magnet with it.) You did it! You saved us, Perry the Platypu- (The tinfoil crashes through the building.) Curse you, Perry the Platypus! (The Magnifier gets attached by the magnet. The magnet gets attached to the whole rollercoaster, which begins to rumble as it follows the helicopter.)

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Candace pulls Linda into the Mart's parking lot.) Look, look, look, see? (The coaster gets lifted by the helicopter just before Linda looks.)

Name: Linda
Dialog: (pause) Okay, I give up. What am I supposed to be looking at?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (turns to see the empty parking lot) No! It's not possible!

Name: Linda
Dialog: (going back inside) I'm gonna go get the cart.

Name: Candace
Dialog: It was right here, and it was huge! (sees the rollercoaster fly away) Mom!

Name: Linda
Dialog: (walks past, taking her cart) Time to go. I've got frozens.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Okay, so you think that Phineas and Ferb are still under that stupid tree in the backyard, right?

Name: Linda
Dialog: Well, yes, that would be my guess.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (pushes Mom's cart) Fine. Then let's go home now!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, there you are, Perry. (Perry, now in pet mode, chatters) Nice hat, Isabella. (Isabella takes off Agent P's fedora and looks at it, confused.; The car goes to the end of the track and flies onto a construction area, then a crane flings in into the air.) Funny, I don't remember this in the blueprints. (An airplane picks up the car by the tail.) And I'm sure this is new.

Name: Linda
Dialog: I worry about you sometimes, Candace.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Welcome to Mr. Slushy Burger. May I take your order?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Anyone want fries? (Before taking any orders, the tree bends back and throws them to Paris, where they land on the Eiffel Tower, which bends so they end up in front of a croissant stand.)

Name: French Man
Dialog: Croissant?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Anyone want a... (French accent) "croissant"? (Before taking any orders, the Eiffel Tower bends back and flings the car into space. A satellite flies by.) You know, if that thing crashes to Earth, Candace is in charge. (The car suddenly falls back to Earth. The front of the car begins to burn like a meteor.) We should have charged more.

Name: Linda
Dialog: (pulls the car on the driveway and Candace jumps out.) Okay, we're here. Are you happy now, Candace?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (laughing gleefully; looks in the backyard and doesn't see her brothers.) Yes! (at Linda) See, Mom? I told you they weren't there! (She gestures toward the tree with her eyes closed while leaves rustle off-screen.)

Name: Linda
Dialog: (Linda pokes her head through the gate opening and smiles.) Oh, hi, boys. (Candace opens her eyes and her mood changes to shock)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (He and Ferb are now under the tree.) Hi, Mom.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Come on, Candace. Help me with the groceries. (goes off)

Name: Candace
Dialog: But, but, but, but, but, but, but... (continues under)

Name: Linda
Dialog: (overlapping in the middle of Candace's sputtering) Let's go. (pulls her away)

Name: Kid
Dialog: (Kids come down from the tree.) Hey, Phineas, that was great.

Name: Pedro
Dialog: Way too cool.

Name: Third kid
Dialog: That was awesome! Can we do it again?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (the coaster is burning on top of the tree.) Sorry, only one ride per customer.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (coming down from the tree) That was great, Phineas! So, what are you gonna do tomorrow?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Don't know yet.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (pets Perry) Maybe you can teach Perry some tricks.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, he is a platypus, they don't do much.

Name: Ferb
Dialog: They're the only mammals to lay eggs. (Pause)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Maybe he'll lay an egg.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Cool. See you tomorrow. (goes to the gate) It really was the coolest coaster ever. You guys make a great team.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, a brother is a brother, but I couldn't have asked for a better one than Ferb. You know what I mean? (Ferb burps) Oh-ho-ho, man! I could smell the peanut butter!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Well, that was impressive. (leaves) See you, guys.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: So, what **should** we do tomorrow? There's a world of possibilities. Maybe we should make a list. (The coaster explodes in the tree. A car alarm goes off and a dog barks.)

Name: Candace
Dialog: (from inside) Mom!

Name: Linda
Dialog: (from inside) Give it a rest, Candace!
